health.collection_scope: Commercial Building and Electrical Permits: rolling 30-day issuance / 7-day status changes, plus literal data center/data centre initial backfill issued 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30, rechecked within the same counted query.
health.coverage_limitation: City limits only; literal-keyword backfill is not all data-center work. Older status changes outside the overlap or fixed backfill are not comprehensively monitored. Permit-listed names and permit-listed phones do not establish current employment or buying authority.

health.collection_scope: Chicago new construction, renovation/alteration and Express Electrical Work permits; 30-day issue window plus 2-day modification overlap; scope, full address, parcel, application start, permit milestone and named party roles retained.
health.coverage_limitation: Chicago status monitoring uses the official Socrata :updated_at row timestamp with a two-day overlap. Longer outages can miss changes; a dataset-wide replacement may exceed the bounded row limit and will fail visibly. Express Electrical Work includes small and residential work; inclusion in collection does not guarantee Signal admission. No dedicated procurement or commissioning coverage.

health.collection_scope: Georgia EPD current draft Title V, SIP and synthetic-minor listing; narratives and draft permits including bounded generator schedule excerpts and draft front-page facility identity; application links retained when present.
health.coverage_limitation: Not a complete air-application registry. Current application-link fields are empty; full applications may require agency request. Public notices are references only. At most 24 generator excerpts per PDF, 8 general pages; bounds and omitted excerpt counts are retained. Installed standby ratings are not rental demand.

health.collection_scope: Four most recent weekly XLSX reports linked on official Sold Permits Search page; all rows in those workbooks. Permit date is an event, not report publication time.
health.coverage_limitation: Not complete sold-permit history or electrical/commissioning coverage. No contractor/person/contact fields in these reports. Latest linked report on 2026-09-30 ends 2026-09-14 (16-day lag); latest listing over 30 days old fails visibly. Earlier revisions outside four reports are not monitored.

Seattle exposes no per-row status-change date; Socrata :updated_at was refreshed across 193257 rows in the same recent interval, so it is not a reliable row-change signal. Older permit status edits are not monitored by this discovery query. Remedy: add a bounded worker query for previously retained active permit IDs or a source lifecycle feed.
Bounded rolling Taylor CivicPlus Development News/Notices categories 30/31 archive lookback with configured overlap; no atomic upstream snapshot is available.

health.collection_scope: All framed permit groups in current daf420.dat plus previous calendar month official end-of-month snapshot. One permit identity; lowest sequence is newest amendment. Older retained entities are never deleted by snapshot absence.
health.coverage_limitation: Not all historical Texas permits. No pending-application feed or older-month correction monitoring. Outages longer than the prior-month overlap can miss activity. Current file over four days old, missing previous-month EOM, changed framing, or bounds fail visibly. Production date, load, fuel suitability, rental demand and contacts are UNKNOWN.
